composition.group_result_usage: acc_q47_48_o only; the primitive FP16 result is not accumulated
composition.final_rounding: one binary16 round-to-nearest-ties-to-even conversion after every input group has been summed

reused: separate start, pair, metadata, and output ready-valid channels
active-low asynchronous reset, synchronous clear abort, and output retention until acceptance
adapted: ACE-2 output-major shell scheduling becomes output-major then G128-group-major sequencing with explicit native tensor indices
ACE-2 variable-ready protocol tests become deterministic metadata, pair, and output stalls plus stable-output checks
the independent fixed-point reference pattern becomes an independent native-AWQ FP16 oracle
replaced: signed symmetric INT4 by INT8 arithmetic and fixed multiplier/right-shift requantization
shell-coupled memory addressing and writeback, which are outside this stream-engine milestone
ace2_evolution_audit.copy_policy: No ACE-2 arithmetic RTL is copied. Compatible interface and control patterns are re-expressed for native asymmetric AWQ W4A16 semantics and verified independently.

accumulator.width_derivation: 96 group bits + ceil(log2(38 maximum groups)) = 102 bits
accumulator.overflow_policy: sign-extend and add every accepted 96-bit group result exactly; no internal saturation or wrap is possible for up to 38 representable group results
accumulator.final_overflow: saturate only during the single final binary16 conversion

streaming.start: first_output_channel_i plus output_count_i selects a contiguous output tile within OUT_FEATURES
streaming.metadata_order: for each output channel in ascending order, groups 0 through IN_FEATURES/128-1
streaming.pair_order: within each group, input indices group*128 through group*128+127
streaming.backpressure: metadata, pair, and output channels use ready/valid; output channel, result, accumulator, invalid, and saturation remain stable while stalled
streaming.reset: active-low asynchronous abort and state clear
streaming.clear: active-high synchronous abort and state clear

sequential_cycle_model.per_group_without_stalls: 1 metadata acceptance + 128 pair acceptances + 1 group-result collection = 130 cycles
sequential_cycle_model.output_visibility: out_valid is visible after the final group-result collection; output acceptance consumes one additional cycle
